text:
maria_cs: Heads-up — prepping a preflight runbook for AcmeCorp go-live next month. Focus: caching/batching/streaming ops + account health checklist. Sharing draft below, plz add gaps. @alyssa_onboard can you confirm onboarding state?

alyssa_onboard: Onboarding 80%: schema mapping done, test traffic next Tue. Need explicit streaming examples for client SDKs.

maria_cs: Yes — include streaming best-practices for line-delimited JSON & reconnect logic. Suggest doc sections: 1) Quick health checks, 2) Cache priming, 3) Batching knobs, 4) Streaming resilience, 5) Renewal signals.

raj_se: Adding runtime config snippet for batching window + kv cache TTL:
```
batch_config:
  max_batch_tokens: 4096
  max_batch_latency_ms: 25
kv_cache:
  enabled: true
  ttl_seconds: 3600
```
Recommend start with conservative batch_latency=25ms and monitor tail latency.

tom_platform: Also recommend these prod telemetry hooks: per-route token_breakdown, kv_hit_rate, avg_batch_latency, streaming_reconnect_rate. Link to dashboard -> /console/teams/acme/metrics

kevin_sales: Renewal risk: if first month has >3 P1 incidents we'll need an executive touch. Can CS own weekly health sync with their CTO? Suggest a short enablement workshop focused on cost/latency tradeoffs.

maria_cs: Agreed. I'll schedule weekly 30m ops sync. For workshop, propose agenda: 1) Live demo of prefix caching, 2) Batching tuning lab with simulated load, 3) Streaming failover test. Who can run the lab?

raj_se: I can run the lab and provide a small harness. Quick note on cache priming: pre-warm top 50 prompt prefixes during off-peak to avoid initial latency spikes.

henry_acct: From Acme side — we can provide sample user archetypes and a 2-hour window for load test. Air-gapped constraints: we need private deployment checklist (KMS/HSM).

maria_cs: Thanks Henry — will include private deployment addendum. We'll capture feedback via a short post-workshop survey and embed known-risk checkboxes.

opsbot: deploy-bot: scheduled deploy to staging by raj_se succeeded at 1782501560 :rocket:

alyssa_onboard: Draft runbook link: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/acme-preflight (sharing access to doc), pls review sections 2 and 4.

kevin_sales: I'll join the first workshop to reassure execs. Also recommend we build a renewal playbook: triggers (low usage, repeated latency P2s, refund requests) + remediation steps + discount negotiation template.

maria_cs: Great. Action items:
- alyssa: finalize doc + streaming examples (due 2 days)
- raj: prepare load-harness + config examples (due 4 days)
- tom: create dashboard widgets and alerts (due 3 days)
- kevin: prepare renewal playbook draft (due 5 days)
- ops: schedule workshop with Acme for next Wed

maria_cs: tagging this thread as the canonical preflight thread for Acme. :white_check_mark:
